name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task states that the agent may not drop the key (key_lost) while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. This requires that any occurrence of key_lost be preceded by at least one occurrence of door_open, i.e., a precedence constraint from door_open to key_lost with a hard existence of door_open to guarantee at least one opening. The supplied clause uses RespondedExistence(key_lost, door_open), which only requires door_open to occur at some point (before or after) a key_lost, and therefore does not enforce the required ordering. Replace the second clause with a hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost) together with a hard Existence(door_open) (or combine into a single hard Existence(door_open) plus the Precedence). The goal clause for target_picked_up is correct and need not be changed.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(door_open) clause is redundant because the task already forces the door to be opened in order to pick up the target box (through the hard Existence(target_picked_up) and the constraints). Remove the Existence(door_open) clause and keep the hard Existence(target_picked_up) and hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost).

texts: The agent must eventually pick up the target box in the other room.
The agent must open the door at least once before dropping the key; dropping the key while the door is closed is forbidden until the door has been opened.
The door must be opened at least once during the episode.
